_doc: Salt Creek's cemetery (#1142, the building lab; src/world/cemetery.gd): on the hill north-west of the church (valley.json place `cemetery`, its pad 40 x 30 m at y 10.5), a tall close white picket fence round a yard of bare ground with a plank gate on its south side, where Church Lane arrives. Graves are laid in close rows by seed (#1170), most a heavy wooden cross with a name board or a headboard, a few arched headstones and small stone markers (the kinds are the prop lab's: tools/props/church.py); the funeral's graves ([config/moments/funeral.json] `old_graves`, [east, south] of its `grave`) are laid first, at the same places, so the scene's stand-in blocks are real. The new grave itself is the funeral's (src/missions/funeral.gd), dug when the funeral starts.

rows._doc: the graves after the funeral's: rows east-west from the back (north) fence, `along` apart in a row, rows `apart`, `fill` the share of cells used; once `graves_max` are laid the rest of the sites are left free for the game's dead (Cemetery.free_plots, claim_plot)
